cut_optimization.method: nested five-fold source-group OOF; validation and test excluded

non_broad_train_rows.model_feature_policy: candidate-dependent features are null; rows are not used to fit the resolved classifier
non_broad_train_rows.reason: fewer than four selected jets means a resolved HH->4b candidate cannot be constructed

resolved_model_view.interpretation: This is a model-input preselection, not a reduction of the train partition.
resolved_model_view.selection: broad_event_eligible == true, equivalent to at least four selected AK4 jets with pT > 30 GeV and |eta| < 2.5
